\section{Robustness to Rent Treatment and Income Definition}
\label{sec:app-income-definition}

\subsection{Rent Treatment}
\label{sec:app-rent-treatment}

The baseline removes actual and imputed rents before constructing matched product baskets and
renormalizes the remaining weights. Table~\ref{tab:rent-mapping-robustness} compares this baseline
with two alternatives: mapping both actual and imputed rents to HICP actual rents, and retaining
actual rents only. The sensitivity exercise uses relative-expenditure weights and therefore need
not reproduce the RAS-based baseline estimates. It reports the individual P20--P80 range because
rent treatment can alter inflation dispersion when rent shares differ across households.

\input{tables/tab_EA20_rent_mapping_robustness_2021_06_2023_06}

\subsection{Income Definition}

The baseline ranks households by total net household income. Table~\ref{tab:income-definition-robustness} tests whether this choice drives the measured inflation gap. We keep the household inflation rates, sample, consumption coverage, and weights fixed, and reassign national quintiles using equivalized income.
